_doc: Recorded rule exceptions (AGENTS.md, 'Project profile'). An entry with only rules_id excuses findings of that advisory rule in that function; its code carries /* RULE-EXCEPTION: <rule>, <reason> */. An entry with status 'match_pending' is revoked: it excused a [match] rule (R4, R17), so the function is MATCH-PENDING and the entry keeps the evidence. volatile_allow lists the genuine hardware/IRQ volatile objects (R17).

exceptions.rule: type pun *(T *)&x; a named member or helper reads better
exceptions.deviation: the four texture words of each panel's spriteUV_t are copied with *(u_long *)&uv->u0..u3 chains
exceptions.reason: exact byte match; retail copies each texture word once into the four panels with one lw and four sw (as DrawScreenSpriteSemi does); a chained spriteUV_t struct copy compiles 164 bytes larger

exceptions.rule: no fake code, storage, labels
exceptions.deviation: a failed command chain leaves through goto failed to a block after the function's final store
exceptions.reason: exact byte match; same layout as Trigger_PlayerCell (failure block after the shared last-trigger store)

exceptions.rule: source must be defined for every input the machine code accepts
exceptions.deviation: the C shift count is undefined for IDs 0 and below -1; retail's machine code accepts them
exceptions.reason: exact byte match; AGENTS.md 'Keep every exact match' keeps it and records the deviation

exceptions.rule: access goes through typed members; no raw offset casts
exceptions.deviation: neighbour cells reached by a byte-stride cast (mapCell_t *)((u8 *)a +/- stride) instead of typed indexing
exceptions.reason: exact byte match only with this spelling: typed neighbour spellings add the scaled index as addu (w<<4, a), retail adds (a, stride); kept under AGENTS.md 'Keep every exact match'

exceptions.reason: exact byte match only with this spelling (block->rowCount/block->rows change the function size); kept under AGENTS.md 'Keep every exact match'

exceptions.rule: an unused local is fake code unless it is an evidenced dead local (R17-dead-local)

exceptions.reason: type, name and 16-byte size from Object_DrawLevelObjectTall, whose body this is minus ScaleMatrix, with VECTOR scale in the same 0x18(sp) slot; ruled out: inlined callee (a shared inline panel-draw helper gives a 0x38 frame), aggregate temporary, SDK macro locals, dead scale stores

exceptions.rule: no fake locals or padding to move codegen
exceptions.deviation: declares an unused 'SVECTOR unused;' local for retail's frame size
exceptions.reason: declared aggregates reserve frame space even when unused (GCC 2.5.7), but nothing evidences this 8-byte local's type (Particle_DrawModel keeps scale only), so it is not an R17-dead-local exception; no inlined callee, aggregate temporary or SDK macro local explains the slot

exceptions.rule: an unused local is fake code unless it is an evidenced dead local (R17-dead-local)
exceptions.deviation: declares an unused 'CVECTOR color;' local that reproduces retail's untouched 8 bytes at 0x10(sp)
exceptions.reason: type, name and size from Particle_DrawSteam and Particle_DrawFire, which keep CVECTOR color in the same slot of the same 0x30 frame; ruled out: inlined callee, aggregate temporary, SDK macro local, a live colour copied through color (20 bytes larger)

exceptions.rule: no fake labels or control flow to shape codegen
exceptions.deviation: the object loop is written as goto nextObject / objectLoop instead of a while or for loop
exceptions.reason: retail enters the loop with a jump to its bottom test and keeps no copy of the test before the first object; every while/for/do spelling tried (while, for with increment, assignment in the condition, block-local declarations) gets GCC's duplicated top test (beqz) and is 1 word short of exact; kept under 'Keep every exact match'

exceptions.rule: a do { } while (0) wrapper only as a macro that groups one coherent operation
exceptions.deviation: NEXT_DIGIT (read the digit after a control character) is used in the '$' case only; the '!', '%' and '&' cases open-code the same two statements
exceptions.reason: exact only this way: with the macro at all four sites the build is 32 bytes short, without it the '$' case addresses x and position by symbol instead of through the text pointer's register (16 bytes long); kept under 'Keep every exact match'

exceptions.rule: access goes through typed members; no raw offset casts
exceptions.deviation: tests the first word of Actor.velocity (vx and vy together) with *(long *)&actor->velocity
exceptions.reason: retail loads the pair with one lw at +0x30 (0x80036090); member compares emit lh; kept under AGENTS.md Keep every exact match

exceptions.reason: retail copies the colour with one lw/sw (0x80034c40, 0x80034c50) and then stores the code byte; member stores emit lbu/sb; kept under AGENTS.md Keep every exact match

exceptions.rule: casts only at real boundaries
exceptions.deviation: frame->x, y, w and h are read through (u_short) casts: spriteFrame_t's offsets are short (Actor_DrawSprite and Actor_DrawShadowed load them with lh into signed arithmetic) but this overlay draw adds them as unsigned halfwords (lhu)
exceptions.reason: exact byte match; kept under AGENTS.md 'Keep every exact match'

exceptions.rule: no fake code, storage, labels
exceptions.deviation: unused 'RECT unused[2]' local
exceptions.reason: exact byte match; retail's frame holds 9-16 unused bytes; 16 = the two RECTs Menu_BlankScreen/Menu_ClearDisplayArea/Menu_ClearVRAMArea declare; ruled out: all three are jal calls, no inline helper, macro or aggregate temporary, no Probe lineage counterpart

exceptions.rule: no fake code, storage, labels
exceptions.deviation: unused 'char number[8]' local
exceptions.reason: exact byte match; retail's frame holds 2-8 unused bytes; char number[8] is Menu_FormatValueLabel's digit buffer for the same decimal; ruled out: Menu_FormatDecimal is a jal, strcpy builtins use register block moves, no macro or aggregate temporary

exceptions.rule: no fake code, storage, labels
exceptions.deviation: unused 'unsigned char codes[PASSWORD_LENGTH]' local
exceptions.reason: exact byte match; retail's 0x48 frame holds 25-32 unused bytes; codes[PASSWORD_LENGTH] is the unit's password code buffer; ruled out: Password_ClearWeaponAmmo has no locals, every other callee is a jal, passwordRecord_t (20 bytes) is too small
